articles.title: Swift’s $1.5 quadrillion network faces a blockchain test
articles.snippet: Crypto executives say new blockchain payment infrastructure could make Swift obsolete. Bankers say its 11,500-institution network gives it the power to absorb the technology instead.

articles.title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
articles.snippet: This latest U.S. appeals court ruling sets up a rift between federal courts on event contracts, suggesting the U.S. Supreme Court may need to settle the matter.

articles.title: Solana vote to double disinflation passes by a hair in dramatic finish
articles.snippet: Solana's first network-wide vote went down to the wire, with Kraken and Galaxy-linked validators switching sides before the disinflation proposal narrowly passed.

articles.title: SBI buys 20% stake in Indonesia's Ajaib for $270 million to expand yen stablecoin in Southeast Asia
articles.snippet: The Japanese financial giant is acquiring a 20% stake in the Indonesian online brokerage to build a cross-border, blockchain-based settlement network.

articles.title: Circle's USDC takes over Chelsea's jersey in Premier League first sponsorship deal
articles.snippet: Financials were not disclosed, though reports from earlier this year suggested Chelsea was targeting 65 million pounds a year ($88.3 million) for the sponsorship berth.
